title: AO/88/2016 of Gulam Jafar AND ANOTHER Vs New India Insurance Company Ltd AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Appeal from Order No. 88/2016
Gulam Jafar & Another Ö. Appellants

Versus
New India Insurance Co. Ltd. & Others .Ö Respondents
Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate, for the appellants/claimants.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate, for the insurance company/respondent
no. 1.
None for the remaining respondents.
 July 24th, 2017

Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Having heard the rival contentions, it is evident
that the accident, losing of life by the deceased Mohd. Rafi
and the insurance cover of the truck no. HR55-A-6806
have not been disputed, but the fact remains that the
tribunal while adjudicating the issue no. 1 in the impugned
judgment dated 28.11.2015 has held that this accident has
been caused on account of dashing of the two vehicles from
in front. One was truck bearing the number as indicated
above, and another was the tractor attached with a trailer
carrying 22-23 passengers in such trailer without bearing
any registration number and this tractor was being driven
by Mr. Gulam Jafar.
The claimants, who are the parents and the
brothers and sisters of the deceased, have not impleaded
the insurance company, owner or driver of that tractor as
the necessary parties. So, the learned tribunal after
determining the total amount of award to the tune of Rs.
2,62,000/- has slashed it by 50 per cent to apportion the
liability of the tractor.
I think there is no infirmity in slashing such
award because it has been done by the tribunal on account
of finding the contributory negligence on the part of the

2
tractor driver, but the claimants did not implead the owner,
driver or insurance company of such tractor. Therefore, the
award has been slashed for the non-joinder of necessary
parties.
So, this appeal is partly allowed in the term that
the interest on the amount of compensation shall be paid
with effect from the date of institution of the claim petition.
With the modification to this extent only, the impugned
award is upheld.
Let the LCR be sent back.
